low.title: Full-Day Mixed Hallstatt Route on a Low Budget
low.summary: A full day mixing art, nature, history, and affordable local bites — perfect for exploring Hallstatt without overspending.

schedule.title: Lakeside Wake-Up + Scenic Walk
schedule.description: Start the morning along Hallstätter See with quiet reflections, mountain views, and early light — ideal for simple photos.

schedule.title: Old Town Art & Architecture Corners
schedule.description: Stroll through narrow lanes, colorful façades, cute balconies, and the iconic postcard viewpoint.

schedule.title: Budget Bakery Snack
schedule.description: Grab a pastry, pretzel, or simple sandwich to keep the energy flowing.

schedule.title: Church Area + Panoramic Roof Views
schedule.description: Head up toward the church terrace for one of the best angles of Hallstatt’s rooftops and lake.

schedule.title: Low-Cost Local Lunch
schedule.description: Choose an affordable Austrian daily menu — simple soups, noodles, or a small hot dish.

schedule.title: Nature Walk Toward the Waterfall
schedule.description: Follow the easy paths above the village toward Mühlbach waterfall — soothing nature + old mill history in one spot.

schedule.title: Sunset by the Lake
schedule.description: Relax on a bench or pier as the sun dips behind the mountains — the perfect mixed-route ending.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day Mixed Hallstatt Experience
medium.summary: A well-rounded day blending culture, viewpoints, nature walks, and mid-range local meals.

schedule.title: Café Breakfast by the Lake
schedule.description: Enjoy a warm drink and a light breakfast with beautiful water and mountain reflections.

schedule.title: World Heritage Museum Highlights
schedule.description: Get a cultural and historical overview of Hallstatt — early settlements, salt mining, and alpine traditions.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: A classic Austrian dish in a comfortable restaurant — hearty but not too heavy.

schedule.title: Old Town Loop + Photo Stops
schedule.description: Visit Marktplatz, lakeside houses, and charming alleys perfect for landscape and architecture shots.

schedule.title: Church Terrace + Quiet Upper Path
schedule.description: Climb to the church for panoramic views, then follow the path toward the small waterfall stream.

schedule.title: Nature Walk & Cool Stream Views
schedule.description: Enjoy the soothing sound of mountain water and shaded pathways — natural recharge time.

schedule.title: Evening Lakeside Chill
schedule.description: Round off the day with a calm lakeside stroll as the village lights begin to glow.

high.title: High-End Mixed Hallstatt Day
high.summary: A premium blend of art, nature, culture, and refined local dining — ideal for travelers who want the full Hallstatt experience.

schedule.title: High-Quality Café Breakfast
schedule.description: Start with a scenic, comfortable breakfast overlooking the lake.

schedule.title: Museum – Extended Cultural Tour
schedule.description: Explore full sections on archaeology, early settlements, and regional crafts.

schedule.title: Premium Local Lunch
schedule.description: Taste elevated Austrian dishes made with fresh local ingredients.

schedule.title: Hallstatt Skywalk
schedule.description: Ride up for one of the most breathtaking panoramic views in the Alps — village + mountains + lake all in one shot.

schedule.title: Salt Mine Exterior & Mountain Walk
schedule.description: Explore the historical mining area surroundings and enjoy crisp mountain air and views.

schedule.title: Old Town Fine Architecture Loop
schedule.description: Return to the village for an elegant walkthrough of its most iconic houses and streets.

schedule.title: Lakefront Dinner Atmosphere
schedule.description: Finish with a nicely prepared dinner while watching the evening colors on the water.

comfortable.title: Luxury Mixed Full-Day Hallstatt Journey
comfortable.summary: A polished all-in-one day that blends curated viewpoints, cultural insights, relaxing nature, and elegant dining.

schedule.title: Luxury Breakfast with Mountain View
schedule.description: Begin with a refined breakfast in a high-end restaurant overlooking Hallstätter See.

schedule.title: Private or Curated Museum Experience
schedule.description: Dive deep into local history, ancient artifacts, and visual exhibitions.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Lunch
schedule.description: A beautifully prepared multi-course meal inspired by alpine flavors.

schedule.title: Skywalk Signature Panoramic Experience
schedule.description: Enjoy unmatched views from the iconic platform — a must for photography lovers.

schedule.title: Exclusive Mountain Terrace Break
schedule.description: Relax at an upper-station terrace or viewpoint with serene alpine surroundings.

schedule.title: Old Town + Lakefront Premium Walk
schedule.description: Return through the prettiest paths and balconies of the old village.

schedule.title: Luxury Dinner + Evening Reflections
schedule.description: End your mixed adventure with a refined dinner beside the glimmering lake.
